Kolding Sygehus is a hospital located in the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) that reports data for supplementary analyses of cancer diseases among acute surgical patients [^src1]. 

The hospital is referenced in the 2024 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen, AKDB), which analyzes patient composition and the distribution of cancer diagnoses among operated patients during the period from September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023 [^src1]. This data collection is part of a broader quality development initiative led by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram) [^src1]. The detailed regional and hospital-level information reported by Kolding Sygehus is used to assess indicator 11, which tracks 90-day mortality [^src1]. Because comorbidities such as cancer are known predictors of postoperative outcomes, this data is essential for adjusting quality targets and risk-adjusting clinical indicators [^src1].
